Not by default. December 22nd falls inside the year-end code freeze, which runs Dec 15 to Jan 5 while Finance runs the annual close. No production release may go out in that window, hotfixes included, unless a lead in #fin-eng signs off in the channel first.

**Your options:**
- **Ship before the freeze.** Tag the release by Dec 14. Dec 22 isn't a Friday (it's a Tuesday), so the Friday-after-14:00-UTC rule isn't a problem. You'd just need the PR template's release checklist done and a billing-team member to approve the production promotion in the CI UI.
- **Get a freeze exception.** Ask in #fin-eng and get explicit sign-off from a lead before tagging. Finance wants this fix, so that sign-off may be easy to get. Keep the sign-off linked in the release PR.
- **Wait until after Jan 5.** This is the fallback if neither of the above works.

If you do release, tag it `vYYYY.MM.N` (for example `v2026.12.1`) and let CI publish it. Any database migrations the fix needs must ship in that same release.

I got this from the project's stored release notes. I haven't checked whether the freeze dates have changed this year, so confirm them in #fin-eng.
